fit_reason: Private owner selling a complete 14 ft Lund aluminum boat with outboard and trailer.
findings: Scuffing and worn patches in the light green interior paint on the floor and transom area near the motor
Dirt and debris on the interior floor between the seats
Dull, slightly faded red paint along the hull sides
Hazy, weathered bare aluminum on the lower hull and gunwale rails
Light grime on the padded seats
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lund and motor. It looks like a solid boat, and a cleanup of the floor dirt and a buff on the red hull sides and aluminum rails would help it pop in photos. We do pre-sale details and come to you. Would you like a quote?
